Show how an empty MIME type is rejected consistently.

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper().setPropertyNamingStrategy(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.PropertyNamingStrategies.SNAKE_CASE)
    try {
    val input = mapper.readValue("{\"bytes\":[84,104,105,115,32,105,115,32,97,32,112,108,97,105,110,32,116,101,120,116,32,102,105,108,101,32,102,111,114,32,116,101,115,116,105,110,103,46,10],\"config\":{},\"filename\":\"plain.txt\",\"kind\":\"bytes\",\"mime_type\":\"\"}", ExtractInput::class.java)
    val config = mapper.readValue("{\"url\":{\"crawl\":{\"ssrf\":{}}}}", ExtractionConfig::class.java)
    val result = Xberg.extract(input, config)
    } catch (error: Exception) {
        System.err.println("${error::class.simpleName}: ${error.message}")
    }
}
```
